dashboards.name: Exotiq Rent — Paid Ads & Booking Requests
dashboards.description: Consent-based public booking-site analytics only; scoped to book.exotiq.rent/exotiq. A successful request is a Lead, not a Purchase. Revenue, approved checkout, backend payment and Meta spend are not implemented in this browser release. Existing marketing-site dashboards are unchanged.

insights.name: EXR · Daily visitors and booking requests
insights.description: Distinct consented visitors versus successfully saved requests. No paid-booking claims.

insights.name: EXR · Storefront to vehicle
insights.description: Storefront-entry journey only. Vehicle-targeted ads can legitimately skip the storefront.

insights.name: EXR · Vehicle to submitted request
insights.description: Vehicle → dates → driver → review → request accepted. Approval and payment happen later and are not measured here yet.

insights.name: EXR · Visitors by campaign
insights.description: Latest permitted campaign touch; direct return visits retain their campaign. Untagged/denied visitors cannot be attributed retroactively.

insights.name: EXR · Requests by ad ID
insights.description: Stable Meta ad ID when present in landing URL parameters. Not paid bookings or attributed Meta ROAS.

insights.name: EXR · Requests by vehicle
insights.description: Successful booking requests by vehicle; exclude payments and speculative daily-rate revenue.

insights.name: EXR · Public visitors by device
insights.description: Coarse device category only, no raw browser fingerprint or form information.

dashboards.name: Exotiq Rent — Tracking Health
dashboards.description: Browser tracking coverage and consented campaign data. Internal QA uses an excluded campaign marker. No paid/revenue event is emitted by this release. Compare backend totals separately because denied/blocked visits will be absent.

insights.name: EXR · Funnel event volumes
insights.description: Checks that all active public funnel stages are arriving.

insights.name: EXR · Incoming sources
insights.description: Latest source label: facebook/instagram/fb/ig as tagged in ads, other sources or unknown.

insights.name: EXR · Public pages receiving events
insights.description: Should contain public Exotiq storefront, vehicle and request pages only; never private booking or verification URLs.
